required_forms.description: Certificate from attending physician — cause of death
required_forms.where_to_get: From the hospital/doctor who treated the deceased
required_forms.condition: Required for all natural death claims

required_forms.where_to_get: From hospital where deceased was admitted
required_forms.condition: Required if deceased was hospitalised before death
Required in rural areas or when death cert is disputed

required_documents.doc: NEFT details — cancelled cheque or passbook

required_documents.condition: If claim is disputed or no nominee registered

procedure_steps: Locate the LIC servicing branch using the policy number — call 1800-33-4433
Download and fill Claim Form A from lic.gov.in or collect from branch
Obtain Form B from the attending doctor or hospital — requires doctor signature and stamp
Submit complete dossier to the LIC branch in person
LIC will issue an acknowledgement receipt — keep this safe
Track claim status via lic.gov.in using policy number
LIC sends SMS updates at each stage
Settlement within 30 days for clean claims

contact.visit: LIC servicing branch for the policy

common_rejection_reasons: Form B not signed by attending doctor
Policy was lapsed at time of death — check premium payment status

special_cases.lapsed_policy: Claim may still be valid if lapse was recent. LIC has revival provisions. Check with branch.
special_cases.no_nominee_registered: Succession certificate from civil court required. Claim significantly delayed.
special_cases.disputed_claim: LIC pauses settlement. Succession certificate mandatory. Engage a lawyer.
special_cases.accidental_death: Additional Form D (accident death claim) required. Accidental benefit rider may double the payout.
special_cases.policy_bond_lost: Submit an indemnity bond with surety. Branch will guide the format.
